extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (api.tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Forcing a quality below Original no longer costs you surround. The server was being asked for its default stereo AAC; it now delivers E-AC-3 5.1 where your audio output can take it, at the same bitrate. On a stereo output with no passthrough nothing changes, which is the right answer there. - Choosing "Original" is now told to the server as a deliberate choice rather than looking like no choice at all. - The audio track no longer comes out in the wrong language when the app cannot reach the server for a moment at the start of playback. Your language preferences are remembered on the device and used when that happens. - An explicit subtitle pick no longer stops your preferred audio language from being applied, and the reverse. - Artwork is cleaned up on a schedule instead of accumulating. Settings -> This Device gains a storage limit for it and a way to clear it now. - Artwork downloads once instead of repeatedly on Browse, Search, Discover, filmographies, episode lists and the player's episode drawer.

extension.summary: Install and update the tofa add-on
extension.description: The update channel for tofa's Kodi add-on. Installing this repository lets Kodi fetch the add-on and every later release on its own.
